static_traits.name: Lin Yiwen
static_traits.social_status: 有几个朋友能聊Average话题，但not yet与他们讨论Self-doubt；在Work中因自觉not足而与同事疏远
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往心理治疗或精神科史；此前not yet出现类似心理问题

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直感觉自己在制造汽车方面正在失去天赋，因为上一辆车卖得not快，这导致Self-doubt和Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些Self-doubt影响了我的Work表现和整体幸福感。
growth_experiences: 约一个月前，上一辆车的销售比Anticipation慢，来访者据此产生“自己正在失去天赋”的认知；之后在Work场景中，看到同事的车卖得更快会加剧Self-doubt与Anxiety；因压力（截止日期与财务压力）与持续反刍，出现WorkDecreased drive、与同事疏远、食欲与Sleep affected。

Last year, designed a car that sold quickly and was well received; at that time the client, by devoting effort to the design and absorbing earlier customer feedback, achieved success, and this experience for a time strengthened confidence and a sense of accomplishment.

core_beliefs: 我have not同事那么有才华

special_situations.event: 上一辆车的销售进度比Anticipation慢
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一辆车卖得慢，就说明我have not才华或正在失去天赋
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Extends working hours and proactively seeks others' feedback to prove herself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在失去天赋；我的作品not够好

special_situations.event: Seeing colleagues' cars sell faster at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not如同事表现好，就等于I am not good enough/not天赋
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 疏远同事、Avoids communication以避免羞耻感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们；他们一定觉得I am not good enough

special_situations.event: 回顾过往业绩时，只关注最近一次销售not佳的事实
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有持续、每次都快速销售才算有才华，单次成功not足以证明能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽略积极证据，Reinforcement负面自我评价以督促改进
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 过去的成功并not能说明我真的有能力

special_situations.event: Even when considering market factors (such as a slower market that month or more popular car models), still attributes the outcome to their own ability
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果结果not理想，主要原因一定在我身上
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-blame, reducing communication with others to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault，I am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as talented, work affirmed by the market and praised by peers
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被比较与评判为not够好，害怕失败与羞耻
defense_goal: Keeps distance from others to avoid being compared and humiliated
Proves self-worth through self-pressure and overtime

object_relations.self_representation: 被比较的、not够好的同行者
object_relations.object_representation: More excellent colleagues/market evaluators who may judge oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in avoidant language, shortening answers, reducing details, lowering emotional exposure, and ending the topic.

outcomes: Shaken sense of subjective meaning and self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: have not向朋友表达Self-doubt与Anxiety，选择独自承受
Solves problems through overtime and self-pressure rather than seeking external support

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁Self-denial（“I am not good enough”“我have not天赋”）
Overly cautious in interpersonal contact, reducing communication for fear of being evaluated
